title: Induction on the fuel extra for the closed form of truncated probGeometric
intent: Prove a closed form for every terminating run of the truncated probGeometric loop by induction on the surplus fuel `extra`: the value at `extra + (n + 1)` steps is already known at the minimal fuel by one lemma, and a second lemma says one more step of fuel does not change it.
also_known_as: generalising the loop counter before induction (revert n; induction extra)

parent.name: geometric_characterization
parent.statement:
theorem geometric_characterization (n extra : ℕ) (h : ¬ n = 0) :
  probWhileCut geoLoopCond (geoLoopBody trial) (extra + (n + 1)) (true,0) (false,n) = (trial true)^(n-1) * (trial false)

children.name: geometric_progress'
children.statement:
theorem geometric_progress' (n : ℕ) (h : ¬ n = 0) :
  probWhileCut geoLoopCond (geoLoopBody trial) (n + 1) (true, 0) (false, n) = (trial true)^(n-1) * (trial false)
children.closed_by: trivial, after `have prog := geometric_progress trial (n - 1) 0` and rewrites with `succ_pred h` and `succ_inj.mpr A`
children.note: Base case of the parent's induction: the closed form at the minimal fuel `n + 1`, specialising `geometric_progress` to the run `(true, 0) → (false, n)`.

children.name: geometric_preservation'
children.statement:
theorem geometric_preservation' (n m : ℕ) (h1 : ¬ m = 0) (h2 : n ≥ m) :
  probWhileCut geoLoopCond (geoLoopBody trial) (n + 2) (true,0) (false,m)
  =
  probWhileCut geoLoopCond (geoLoopBody trial) (n + 1) (true,0) (false,m)
children.closed_by: `apply prog; exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right h2 1`, where `prog := geometric_preservation trial (n - 1) (m - 1) 0`
children.note: Step case lemma: one more unit of fuel does not change the value at a `(false, m)` state, under `¬ m = 0` and `n ≥ m`; the parent rewrites the induction hypothesis backwards through it and discharges the side conditions `¬ m = 0` and `n ≥ m`.

applicability.goal_shape: A closed form for a value computed by unrolling a loop `fuel` times (`probWhileCut ... (extra + (n + 1)) ...`), to be shown independent of the surplus fuel `extra`.
applicability.use_when: the value is already known at one fuel bound by a base lemma, and a second lemma says one more step of fuel leaves the value unchanged; then induction on the surplus fuel carries the base to every larger fuel, with the parent only doing the fuel arithmetic.
applicability.avoid_when: the base value or the preservation step is not already proved (here each child closes only by specialising the unprimed `geometric_progress` / `geometric_preservation`, so the real work is one level down); when the value genuinely depends on the surplus fuel, the induction cannot close.
